SYNTHETIC DATA • v1.1.0 • DEVELOPMENT / OFFSET COMPARISON ONLY

## Offset well comparison for target SYN-TARGET-0001

### Well-level summary

| Well | Accepted run count | Accepted footage | Accepted duration | Average penetration rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| SYN-WELL-0002 | 7 | 8,966 ft | 123.95 hr | 72.34 ft/hr |
| SYN-WELL-0019 | 4 | 3,633.2 ft | 124.03 hr | 29.29 ft/hr |

**KPI context:** SYN-WELL-0002 has **3 more accepted runs**, **5,332.8 ft more accepted footage**, and a **43.05 ft/hr higher average penetration rate** than SYN-WELL-0019, with essentially the same accepted duration.

### Section-level support

| Well | Section | Formation | Hole size | MD interval | Accepted runs | Accepted footage | Accepted duration | Penetration rate |
|---|---|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| SYN-WELL-0002 | SYN-SEC-0002-01 | Synthetic Brimstone | 17.5 in | 0 – 6,316 ft | 5 | 6,316 ft | 98.04 hr | 64.42 ft/hr |
| SYN-WELL-0002 | SYN-SEC-0002-02 | Synthetic Cobalt | 12.25 in | 6,316 – 8,966 ft | 2 | 2,650 ft | 25.91 hr | 102.28 ft/hr |
| SYN-WELL-0019 | SYN-SEC-0019-01 | Synthetic Brimstone | 17.5 in | 0 – 2,209.3 ft | 2 | 2,209.3 ft | 71.65 hr | 30.83 ft/hr |
| SYN-WELL-0019 | SYN-SEC-0019-02 | Synthetic Aster | 12.25 in | 2,209.3 – 3,633.2 ft | 2 | 1,423.9 ft | 52.38 hr | 27.18 ft/hr |

### Concise comparison

- **Accepted run count:** SYN-WELL-0002 is higher at **7 vs 4**
- **Penetration rate:** SYN-WELL-0002 is higher at **72.34 vs 29.29 ft/hr**
- **Section support:** SYN-WELL-0002 is stronger in both sections, especially:
  - **Synthetic Cobalt:** **102.28 ft/hr**
  - **Synthetic Brimstone:** **64.42 ft/hr**
- **SYN-WELL-0019** shows lower section rates in both its **Synthetic Brimstone** and **Synthetic Aster** intervals

Source: Fabric semantic-model summary for the synthetic drill-run dataset; measure(s) returned: accepted run count, accepted footage, accepted duration, average penetration rate.
